definitions.full: H7424. rammak [ רַמָּךְ ] noun [feminine] exact meaning dubious (compare Syriac herd ; foreign word; Pahlavi ramak , New Persian , herd of sheep, horses, etc., Thes 1291 Vull ii. 52 ; in Late Hebrew mule born of mare and he-ass); — הָרַמָּכִים בְּנֵי Est 8:10 usually sons of the (royal) mares , said of הָרֶכֶשׁ . רמל (in following compound; Thes compare Arabic adorn with gems; Old Hebrew רמליהו Lzb 369 ).
